coreAttributes.name: 可疑的狗哨
coreAttributes.description: 虽然看起来和普通的狗哨别无二致，但你总隐隐约约察觉到它被附魔了，它能对纯兽狗化形产生强有力的效果……
coreAttributes.onHitEffect: #IF(npc2.getRace()==RACE_DOG_MORPH && npc2.getRaceStage()==RACE_STAGE_GREATER) [npc2.Name] [npc2.verb(stand)] to attention as [npc2.she] [npc2.verb(hear)] the arcane whistle. With [npc2.her] tail uncontrollably wagging in excitement, [npc2.she] [npc2.verb(stand)] to attention and [style.italicsExcellent(completely submits to [npc.herHim])]! [##npc2.setHealth(0)] #ENDIF

hitDescriptions.hitText: 将狗哨举到[npc.her][npc.lips]边，[npc.name]短促而尖利地吹响了它。刺耳的狗哨声中夹杂着微弱而不自然的尖叫声……
